answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fake identities: a newcomer earns standing only after paid work with 8 different counterparties over 3 epochs. To forge a tie, it must complete a signed job: one commissions a sonnet translation, another a garden irrigation plan, and repeat partners do not count. Creating 1,000 fakes needs 8,000 paid relationships, at 10 POA each, 80,000 POA. An honest agent builds 8 real ties once and keeps earnings undiluted.
